evidence.why: Exposes a generic invoke passthrough where the caller chooses the channel and arbitrary args, even though channel is checked against an allowlist; args are forwarded unvalidated to main process handlers (e.g. fs:readFile, fs:writeFile).

Renderer-controlled arguments (e.g. file paths for fs:readFile/fs:writeFile) are passed straight through to ipcRenderer.invoke without validation in preload, delegating all safety to unseen main-process handlers.
